text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills fell to 35.83 percent from 38.70 percent at the last sale on January 21, a central bank statement said on Friday.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 14.94 million UAH 12.74 million UAH
Actual amount raised 13.71 million UAH 11.62 million UAH
The central bank sold 149,382 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 102,107 were competitive and 47,275 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 28.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills fell to 42.51 percent from 47.04 percent at the last sale on January 21, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 15.00 million UAH 15.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 12.38 million UAH 12.15 million UAH
The central bank sold 150,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 1,000 were competitive and 149,000 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 28.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills dropped to 56.90 percent against 59.76 percent at the last sale on January 21, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 127.53 million UAH 109.34 million UAH
Actual amount raised 81.36 million UAH 68.51 million UAH
The central bank sold 1,275,293 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 10,000 were competitive and 1,265,293 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 28.
The auction of nine-month treasury bills scheduled for January 23 was cancelled without explanation, a central bank statement said.
